description: This source file defines the `AppState` class, which manages the application's global state, user preferences, and configuration synchronization. It includes enums for connection modes and transport methods, handles persistence via UserDefaults, manages remote configuration synchronization, and provides methods for voice wake triggers, voice ears, and UI updates.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages application state including user preferences, configuration synchronization, voice wake triggers, and UI elements. Implements observable patterns for reactive updates and contains methods for configuration persistence and external system notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AppState with user defaults, loads configuration, and starts configuration watchers unless in preview mode.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads configuration from disk and applies overrides.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Applies configuration overrides from the loaded config dictionary.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes local gateway configuration with the external config file if there are changes.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates voice ears with an optional time-to-live duration.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake feature with permission handling.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode with permission handling.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets global voice wake triggers, with suppression to avoid sync loops.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a synchronization of voice wake triggers with external gateway.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a saved chime configuration from UserDefaults.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Stores a chime configuration to UserDefaults.
